bridge-type.label: LG Horizon Account
bridge-type.description: An LG Horizon powered TV platform account (Telenet, Ziggo, Virgin Media, UPC, Sunrise, BASE TV). Discovers the set-top boxes registered on the account and provides the connection used to control them.

parameter.name: provider
parameter.label: Provider
parameter.description: Your TV provider. Leave empty / choose "Custom" to configure an unlisted or test backend manually via the advanced Country, API URL and Use Refresh Token fields.

parameter.name: country
parameter.label: Country
parameter.description: Two-letter locale code used in the service-discovery URL path (e.g. "be", "nl", "ch") - not necessarily the same region implied by the provider's name. Known automatically when Provider is set; required if Provider is left empty.

parameter.name: apiUrl
parameter.label: API URL
parameter.description: Base URL of the provider's "spark" REST API, e.g. https://spark-prod-be.gnp.cloud.telenet.tv. Known automatically when Provider is set; required if Provider is left empty.

parameter.name: useRefreshToken
parameter.label: Use Refresh Token
parameter.description: Whether the provider requires refresh-token authentication instead of username/password. Known automatically when Provider is set; only consulted if Provider is left empty.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: Account username/email. Only required for password-based providers

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: Account password. Only required for password-based providers.

parameter.name: refreshToken
parameter.label: Refresh Token
parameter.description: Only required for token-based providers. Sign in to your provider's web player (e.g. telenet.tv) in a browser, open developer tools, and copy the "refresh_token" value out of Local Storage.

thing-type.label: LG Horizon Set-Top Box
thing-type.description: A single LG Horizon set-top box (e.g. a Telenet or Ziggo TV box).

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The LG Horizon device identifier for this box.

parameter.name: profileId
parameter.label: Profile ID
parameter.description: Which household profile's favourite channels and language to use. Defaults to the default box profile or the first profile by account.

channel-type.label: Source Type
channel-type.description: What kind of content is currently active: linear, replay, nDVR, localDVR, reviewBuffer, VOD or app.

channel-type.label: Channel Name
channel-type.description: Name of the channel currently being watched.

channel-type.label: Channel Number
channel-type.description: The logical channel number. Send a number to this channel to change the channel.

channel-type.label: Favorite Channel Number
channel-type.description: The logical favorite channel number. Send a number to this channel to change the channel.

channel-type.label: Series Title
channel-type.description: Name of the TV series/show currently playing, only set for genuinely episodic content (a movie or standalone broadcast leaves this undefined). See Program Title for the always-populated title.

channel-type.label: Episode Title
channel-type.description: Title of the current episode. Falls back to "Episode N" using the episode number if no episode title text is available.

channel-type.label: Season
channel-type.description: Season number of the current episode, when known.

channel-type.label: Episode
channel-type.description: Episode number of the current episode, when known.

channel-type.label: Media Image
channel-type.description: Poster/background image for the current channel, program, VOD title, or recording.

channel-type.label: Stop
channel-type.description: Stops the current playback and returns to live TV.

channel-type.label: Record
channel-type.description: Record selected TV program.

channel-type.label: Channel Up
channel-type.description: Moves to the next channel.

channel-type.label: Channel Down
channel-type.description: Moves to the previous channel.

channel-type.label: Arrow Up
channel-type.description: Navigates up in the on-screen menu.

channel-type.label: Arrow Down
channel-type.description: Navigates down in the on-screen menu.

channel-type.label: Arrow Left
channel-type.description: Navigates left in the on-screen menu.

channel-type.label: Arrow Right
channel-type.description: Navigates right in the on-screen menu.

channel-type.label: Home
channel-type.description: Opens the main menu, or jumps back to the top of the screen from anywhere.

channel-type.label: Info
channel-type.description: Shows information about the current program.

channel-type.label: Context Menu
channel-type.description: Opens the context menu for extra actions (e.g. quickly enabling subtitles, adding the current channel/program to favorites or the watchlist).

channel-type.label: TV
channel-type.description: Switch to live TV.

channel-type.label: Enter / OK
channel-type.description: Confirms the current selection, or opens the channel zap bar during live TV.

channel-type.label: Back / Escape
channel-type.description: Goes back to the previous menu, or stops playback and returns to live TV.

channel-type.label: Send Key
channel-type.description: Send any remote-control key (W3C key name, e.g. "ArrowUp", "Guide", "Red", "MediaRecord") to the box.
